propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces tier wall-clock due to rebar_repo running git init, config, and init_repo per test across 589 test functions (306ms × 589 = 180s overhead)

Session-scoped template built once per xdist worker and copied via shutil.copytree reduces per-test cost from 306ms to 22.3ms (13.7× speedup) if four sharing axes are closed: worktree pointers, gate snapshot store keying, environment identity, and module-global cache
Bare git worktree repair is a silent no-op that leaves copies pointing to template object store and refs, causing writes in a copy to advance the template's refs undetectably

Copying without re-randomizing .env-id and .signing-key violates construction-time enforcement that signatures certify only in their minting environment, because init._gen_local_files() has idempotency guards (if not os.path.isfile) that become silent no-ops on a copy

Template fixture must build inside isolated MonkeyPatch context (REBAR_ROOT, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, reset REBAR_TRACKER_DIR/BRANCH/CONFIG) to prevent contamination from ambient environment of first requester under worksteal scheduling

Autouse guard must use git worktree list --porcelain (not --git-common-dir which structurally cannot witness stale gitdir) to reject half-fixed copies and catch any third pointer future init_repo might add
